title: Eegduu qarqara Lagaa
intro: Biyya labsiin abbaa irree mana hedduutti gadda itti fide keessatti lubbuun tokko ergaa sodaa hunda mormu argatte. Garaa wal amantaan guutameen gocha amantii adeemsa saba tokkoo jijjiiru irratti jalqaban. Bishaan sun feʼumsa gatii guddaa qabu yeroo baatu, abdiin kaarentii wajjin wal makame.
clues: Bara cunqursaa fi sodaa keessa jiraadhe.
Hamilee naaf kenne kaka’umsa waaqayyoon argadhe.
Akkan hin sodaannee fi akkan hin gaddine ajajameera.
Mucaa koo saanduqa keessa kaa'ee bishaan irra kaa'e.
Mucaan koo mana bulchaatiin kan argate yoo ta'u, mucaan koo inni kaan garuu itti aanee dhufe.
Mucaa koo hoosisuudhaaf akkuma Rabbiin waadaa galeetti deebi’ee walitti makame.

trial.label: Yaali/Taatee
options: Duel of magic irratti qormaata ta'uu

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Mucaan kun nagaadhaan gara horsiisituutti deebifame
Mucaan kun gara biyya fagootti geeffame
Mucaan kun daldalaa sooressaa tokkoon guddifachaa fudhate
outcome.answer: Mucaan kun nagaan gara hoosistuutti deebifameera

arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
